name: Mitesh M. Khapra

affiliations.role: Head of AI4Bharat; faculty at IIT Madras

bio: Mitesh M. Khapra is a faculty member in the Department of Data Science and AI at IIT Madras and head of the AI4Bharat research lab, which builds datasets, tools and models for Indian languages. His group's projects include the Samanantar parallel corpus and the IndicTrans2 translation models.
known_for: Samanantar and IndicTrans2 for Indian languages
